description: This Java source file defines an Akka actor class named ThingsUpdater, which manages subscriptions and message forwarding for 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles events related to updating and synchronizing 'things' and their associated policies, utilizing cluster sharding, pub-sub mechanisms, and message processing logic.

classes.name: ThingsUpdater
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for managing subscriptions and message forwarding related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto system. It handles event processing, shard region management, and coordination of 'thing' updates and policy references.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props configuration for spawning a ThingsUpdater actor with specific dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for the actor, mapping message types to processing methods.

methods.name: retrieveShardIds
methods.description: Requests the current set of shard IDs from the shard region for rebalancing subscriptions.

methods.name: updateSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates the subscribed shard IDs based on the latest shard region statistics.

methods.name: handleRetrieveStatisticsDetails
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve statistics details, involving interaction with supplier components.

methods.name: processThingTag
methods.description: Processes incoming ThingTag messages and forwards them accordingly.

methods.name: updateThings
methods.description: Handles out-of-sync 'things' notifications and issues update commands for each item.

methods.name: processPolicyReferenceTag
methods.description: Processes policy reference tags and forwards them.

methods.name: processThingEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming ThingEvent messages, forwarding them to the shard region.

methods.name: forwardJsonifiableToShardRegion
methods.description: Forwards a Jsonifiable message to the shard region, wrapping it in a ShardedMessageEnvelope.

methods.name: forwardEventToShardRegion
methods.description: Forwards an Event message to the shard region in a similar way to JSON messages.

methods.name: forwardToShardRegion
methods.description: Core method that wraps a message in an envelope and sends it to the shard region, respecting namespace blocking.
